# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

First, I want to return the speaker — the more expensive one that isn’t even water-resistant. That’s ridiculous, so I’m not keeping it.

Second, on another order, I want to change the 17-inch laptop to a 13-inch version. If the exact one isn’t available, then tell me all the 13-inch options you do have. I’d rather get an i5 than an i7, and I prefer silver or black over any other color.

My details:
Name: aarav_santos_2259
Emails: aarav.santos8321@example.com and aarav.santos8320@example.com

So can you check that and sort it out?

I can help, but I need to authenticate you first using either:

- your email address, or
- your first name + last name + zip code

I can’t authenticate from a user ID/username alone, and I also need to work only on the authenticated user’s account.

Please provide one of these:
1. which email you want me to use for lookup:
   - aarav.santos8321@example.com
   - aarav.santos8320@example.com
2. or your first name, last name, and zip code

Once I verify your account, I’ll check both orders and see:
- which delivered order has the speaker for return
- which pending order has the 17-inch laptop and what 13-inch options are available

Use **aarav.santos8321@example.com**.

Let’s not drag this out — just authenticate the account and check both orders already.

I couldn’t find an account with aarav.santos8321@example.com.

Please provide either:
- the other email: aarav.santos8320@example.com, or
- your first name, last name, and zip code

Once I authenticate you, I can check both orders.

Fine. Use **aarav.santos8320@example.com**.

Can you please just get on with it and check the speaker return and the laptop change?
